criteria.name: Clear claim
criteria.description: States a clear position that the whole essay defends.

criteria.name: Evidence
criteria.description: Supports the claim with specific, relevant evidence or examples.

criteria.name: Reasoning
criteria.description: Explains how the evidence supports the claim.

criteria.name: Counterclaim
criteria.description: Acknowledges another view and responds to it.

criteria.name: Conventions
criteria.description: Sentences are clear; spelling and punctuation do not get in the way of meaning.
